items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I came from the hospital and brought Dick Donahue a cigar

ctx.x: Please, I don't know. They'll be 20 years old May 8th and the funny part about it, Earl Wilson wrote in the column that I bought $400 worth of cigars and I only bought $2 worth of cigars, because I came from the hospital and brought Dick Donahue a cigar and went down to give the chef something downstairs and then got the hatcheck girl something - I only had $2 left. With these two births which was - and everybody knows that I was sitting with my wife, my new wife, and my daughter, two pregnant women. They offered…
